coordinate_system: native distorted RGB; 1280x720 pixels; origin top-left; integer x,y
evidence: Actual raw RGB images visually inspected at native resolution; no synthetic reconstruction or color threshold used for polygon selection.

semantics.plant_envelopes: Inclusive candidate support; may contain holes, board and other background. Do not treat every interior pixel as plant. Thin/pale structures intentionally preserved.
semantics.nonplant_polygons: Conservative visible pot/soil, board and rig samples. These do not define a global base plane or plant height origin.
semantics.uncertain_polygons: Image regions where attribution is unresolved, particularly projected cross-specimen overlap; keep ambiguous points separately.
semantics.outside_image: No negative evidence. Edge truncation and occlusion mean absence is unknown.
semantics.priority: uncertain overrides definitive plant identity; nonplant exclusion is only for visible reviewed surfaces and should not erase foreground geometry merely sharing a pixel without depth support.
semantics.clear_tissue_polygons: Narrow source-visible tissue traces may override the broad uncertainty envelope only where identity is visually clear. Nonplant exclusions retain priority.

seed_role: Pot/soil review used only to identify specimen; neither base/trait ground truth nor calibrated crop.

views.notes: P3 is the central leafy specimen at pot near (794,411). Envelope deliberately follows its long low trunk and branch to the bottom/right image edges and retains low broad leaves. Bottom-right intertwined stems and the right-side crossing toward P4 are ambiguous. Visible exposed pot/soil patches, board strip, and overhead rig are explicit nonplant samples; no full pot silhouette is erased across foliage. Image-edge truncation must not imply absent geometry.
views.clear_tissue_notes: Raw 3x coordinate-grid review confirms continuous thick P3 branch from the main stem into the lower right blue-grey leafy cluster; narrow branch/leaf-body traces do not include the farther right crossing region. Earlier broad amber area had included this visibly attached tissue.

views.notes: P3 is the leafy pot near (606,413), with thick trunk descending to (515,649). All low leaves and bottom-border branch fragments are retained in the candidate envelope. The lower right branch has uncertain identity where it continues toward P4; the small right crossing is also unresolved. Soil exclusions are only exposed patches, not plant-base or height ground truth.
views.clear_tissue_notes: Magnified raw RGB shows the bottom blue-grey cluster attached to P3 and a continuous horizontal P3 branch ending near x795. No P4 floral structure crosses these narrow traces; outer sparse strands and surrounding holes remain uncertain.

views.notes: P3 is the pot near (408,418) and the broad leaves/trunk extending left/down. P4 flower-bearing thin branches cross in front of its right and low leaves; those overlap areas are explicitly uncertain. P3 low leaves are kept even where their attribution is occluded. The low left edge also mixes fragments of P2 and P3. Yellow blossoms inside an uncertain P3 envelope are not asserted to belong to P3.
views.clear_tissue_notes: The thick P3 stem can be followed continuously from its pot diagonally toward the lower left border. Trace overrides the broad edge uncertainty only along that stem. P2 fragments and P4 thin stems around it retain ambiguity.

views.notes: P4 is the exposed-soil pot near (820,410), whose plant extends strongly right and down. Envelope includes pale/yellow flowers, white/pale buds, thin branching stems and lowest visible yellow flower at (988,670), without color or component-size selection. P4 crosses P5 extensively on the right; those leaves/stems are uncertain rather than assigned from color. Some branches leave right/bottom edges. Upper rig, exposed pot/soil, board, and an unobscured lower rail patch are explicit exclusions.
views.clear_tissue_notes: Narrow traces cover visibly yellow P4 petals attached to its flower stalks; the green/brown P5 organs behind them remain amber. No general color threshold or background region promotion is used.

views.notes: Central P4 view keeps the complete visible flower/bud-bearing envelope, including very pale buds near (868,310), yellow blossoms, pale senescent pieces, fine stems, and bottom yellow flower. Exposed soil is annotated conservatively because buds and thin stems cross the pot. P3 contact on left and P5 contact on right remain uncertain. Lowest stems leave the image and are not reconstructed by annotation.
views.clear_tissue_notes: Distinct pale/cream P4 buds and yellow floral organs are traced narrowly. These are recognizable foreground organs on P4 flower stalks, unlike the broad adjacent P5 leaf overlap. Small clear traces are not full plant segmentation.

views.notes: P4 is the soil-dominated pot near (545,414). It now projects left over P3, so a broad cross-plant overlap is retained as uncertain, including fine stems and yellow flowers. Buds at top near (340,320), pale/cream floral pieces, low yellow flower near (143,684), and thick low stem are preserved in the envelope. This is a weak identity-disambiguation view but valuable corroboration of flower/stem presence. It cannot establish absence at the left or lower border.
views.clear_tissue_notes: Magnified raw source separates the pale bud cluster, yellow petals and two narrow continuous P4 flower stalks in front of the broad P3 leaves. These narrow foreground traces supersede the earlier blanket amber envelope. The surrounding interwoven structures and P3/P4 ownership ambiguity remain amber.
